Implemented the duration formatting utility in the managed workspace. Added duration.py exposing format_duration(total_seconds): returns zero-padded HH:MM:SS strings for nonnegative ints (0->00:00:00, 65->00:01:05, 3661->01:01:01, 360000->100:00:00, hours field not truncated above 99 hours), raises TypeError for booleans and all non-integers, and raises ValueError for negative integers. Added test_duration.py with 9 standard-library unittest cases covering zero, minute/hour boundaries, above-99-hour durations, boolean rejection, non-integer rejection, and negative rejection; all pass via python -m unittest test_duration -v. Updated README.md with usage examples and the exact test command while preserving its existing content; all pre-existing files (probe.txt, probe-head-20260928-160238.txt, uncertain-20260928-160458.txt) are untouched. No external dependencies used.
